claim: QA round 25 (2026-11-07), items 1, 5 and 6 for the Python agents: EmailIntelAgent._detect_unknown_sender reads nothing and flags nothing without a house, and both of its lookups (providers, provider_contacts) stay scoped to the house and escaped, now proved by behaviour (tests/test_email_intel_house_scope.py: two houses, pattern senders; each of the four lookup changes reverted fails a test). The like_exactly docstring no longer promises an escaped * can only miss (PostgREST rewrites it to a literal %), and both test stores (tests/mail_store.py, test_email_sender_attribution.py) apply that rewrite. [Amended 2026-11-11: the lookups read providers.contact_email and contacts via providers!inner(restaurant_id); the old columns do not exist.]
